description: Autonomous Engine for Program Vulnerability Repair and Formal Invariant Verification in CI/CD Pipelines

userStories.title: Project Specification & Memory Bank Scaffolding
userStories.description: Establish the root journal.md, Roo Code Memory Bank, and Ralph PRD loop files.
acceptanceCriteria: journal.md created explaining architectural whys and hows
memory-bank/ directory populated with all 6 context files

userStories.title: Comprehensive Vulnerability & Attack Taxonomy Catalog
userStories.description: Map all user-specified attack vectors (SQLi, NoSQLi, SSTI, ReDoS, LPDoS, BOLA, SSRF, XSS, Secret Leaks) to AST taint patterns and Z3 formal invariant specifications.
acceptanceCriteria: specs/vulnerability-catalog.md documents AST patterns and formal invariants for all attack classes
Clear definition of taint sources, intermediate sanitizers, and execution sinks for each vector
Specification of Z3 SMT logic formula for each vulnerability class

userStories.title: Core AST Taint Localization Engine Prototype
userStories.description: Implement a Tree-sitter parser script in TypeScript that analyzes JavaScript/TypeScript files, traces untrusted input variables (e.g. req.body.id), and flags raw string concatenation reaching SQL database query sinks.
acceptanceCriteria: Tree-sitter parser successfully constructs AST for sample controller
Taint analysis algorithm correctly identifies unescaped variable reaching db.query() sink
Outputs precise file path, line number, column offset, and AST node type

userStories.title: Z3 SMT Invariant Verification Engine
userStories.description: Implement a formal verification module using the Microsoft Z3 solver that takes a candidate patch and mathematically proves that no execution path allows tainted user bytes to reach the query tokenizer.
acceptanceCriteria: Z3 module initializes with First-Order Logic constraints
Correctly returns SAT for parameterized query patches
Correctly returns UNSAT or generates a counterexample for flawed patches

userStories.title: Autonomous Patch Synthesis & Sandboxed Test Chamber
userStories.description: Integrate code model synthesis (local Ollama / cloud API) with a sandboxed test runner (Vitest) to verify that patches resolve vulnerabilities without breaking existing test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Patch synthesizer generates syntactically valid TypeScript/JavaScript diffs
Vitest runner executes against test suite in isolated environment
Reports test pass rate and execution latency in under 1 second

userStories.title: High-Craft Telemetry Dashboard Integration
userStories.description: Connect the core AEGIS engine to the dark mode Next.js/Tailwind cockpit to visualize real-time AST graphs, Z3 invariant proofs, and auto-PR dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: Web dashboard displays side-by-side diff with syntax highlighting
Displays Z3 formal invariant badge (Q.E.D.) and test chamber matrix
Passes 38-point anti-vibecoding quality audit and Apple HIG design standards
